seo.title: Tapestry (Coach): AI-generated e-commerce copy (Persado) - +3 to 5% online revenue (2023)
seo.meta_description: Tapestry, parent company of Coach, uses Persado to generate and optimize its e-commerce language, with +3 to 5% online revenue on personalized web content.
seo.resume_citable: Tapestry, parent company of Coach and Kate Spade, uses Persado to generate and optimize its e-commerce copy, with a 3 to 5% increase in online revenue on personalized web content.

faq.q: What gain does Tapestry report with Persado?
faq.a: A 3 to 5% increase in e-commerce revenue on personalized web content, plus an improvement in conversion and cart abandonment.

faq.q: Where is the generated content used?
faq.a: On checkout and landing pages, site banners and buttons, emails, and post-purchase thank-you pages.

pattern: generation and optimization of personalized marketing language
objectif_business: Grow e-commerce revenue by replacing generic site copy with AI-generated and optimized language, emotional and conversational, close to what an in-store advisor would say.
description: Tapestry, parent company of Coach and Kate Spade, uses Persado to generate and optimize the marketing language of its e-commerce. The platform draws on a dataset from transaction analytics and the interactions of 150 million American consumers to produce emotional and conversational copy. The generated content is deployed on checkout pages, landing pages, site banners and buttons, email campaigns, and post-purchase thank-you pages. Each variant is tested to keep the best-performing wording. Tapestry reports an increase in e-commerce revenue and a decrease in cart abandonment thanks to the personalized content.

resultats.metrique: Increase in e-commerce revenue (personalized web content)
US consumers in the language training base

niveau_preuve.justification: The 3 to 5% e-commerce revenue figure traces back to Persado's product press release of May 16, 2023, which names Tapestry and its program manager and describes the placements plugged in (cart, checkout, landing pages, banners, buttons, email). A quantified vendor case study, backed by two trade press titles (Consumer Goods Technology, Chain Store Age). Note: Persado presents this 3 to 5% as the gain observed across its client brands using Dynamic Motivation, not as an isolated measurement published by Tapestry, which for its part reports conversion and cart abandonment qualitatively.

stack_technique.detail: genAI platform for generating and optimizing marketing language: emotional and conversational variants tested location by location.
Proprietary model trained on transaction analytics and the interactions of 150 million US consumers.
Connected locations: checkout, landing pages, banners and buttons, emails, post-purchase thank-you pages.

fonctionnement_operationnel.cadence: Per campaign and per site location; continuous testing of language variants
fonctionnement_operationnel.opere_par: Tapestry's content optimization and e-commerce team, on the Persado platform
fonctionnement_operationnel.signal_pilote: The measured performance of each variant (click, conversion, revenue). Without enough traffic volume to decide the tests, the selection of the best wording loses its reliability.

etapes.detail: The team targets a high-stakes location (checkout, landing, banner, email).
Persado generates several emotional and conversational wordings from its model.
The variants are tested; the best-performing wording is kept.
The winning content goes live, revenue and abandonment impact is tracked.

prerequis_data: enough e-commerce traffic to decide the tests
access to the copy locations of the site and emails
prerequis_orga: validation process for the generated content
integration of the platform with the CMS and the ESP
replication.equipe: 1 content optimization lead + 1 CRM/e-commerce marketer + 1 dev contact for the CMS/ESP integration.

playbook.action: Choose one or two high-stakes, high-traffic locations (checkout, email) and confirm that the volume allows the tests to be decided.
playbook.livrable: List of prioritized locations and test plan.

playbook.action: Connect the platform to the CMS and the ESP, frame the process for the brand to validate the tone.
playbook.livrable: Working integration and validation guidelines for the generated content.

playbook.action: Generate the variants and test them against the existing copy, location by location.
playbook.livrable: First tests concluded, winning wordings identified.

playbook.action: Deploy the winners, read the revenue and cart abandonment impact, decide on extension to other locations.
playbook.livrable: Quantified review per location and extension roadmap.

replication.premiere_etape: Connect a language generator to a high-traffic location (checkout or email) and compare to the existing copy.

statut_vivant.note: Content personalization program confirmed in 2023; Tapestry has also broadened its use of AI (internal tools Rexy, Mira system) over 2024-2026, a sign of a sustained AI trajectory.

transposable_ue.note: Persado's language model is trained on US consumer interactions. For the EU, retrain on consented local data and adapt the language and tone per market; the generated content remains subject to marketing control.
